name: Roasted Veggie, Dried Fruit & Pistachio Quinoa Bowl with Curry Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small bunches asparagus
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus and cut into 2-inch pieces. Divide between two baking sheet pans.
Trim and cut the zucchini crosswise into thin rounds; divide between baking sheets. Drizzle veggies with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp cumin
¾ tsp turmeric
¾ tsp cinnamon
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until veggies are fork-tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice limes into a medium bowl. Add yogurt and spices; whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp curry powder
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely chop pistachios and place in another medium bowl along with the raisins.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups pistachios, unsalted
¾ cup raisins

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice apricots and add to the bowl with the pistachios; stir to combine.
To serve, divide quinoa between bowls and top with roasted veggies; sprinkle with fruit and nut mix. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!
